okta.title: Okta Setup
okta.description: Register an Okta SAML provider using the values from your Okta application.

fields.domainHelp: Use your tenant or email domain to identify the provider in Better Auth.
fields.entryPointHelp: This is the IdP Single Sign-on URL from Okta or your SAML provider.
fields.acsUrlHelp: Paste this into Okta's Single sign-on URL field.
fields.spEntityIdHelp: Paste this into Okta's Audience URI (SP Entity ID) field. In this app it is also stored as the provider issuer.
fields.spMetadataUrlHelp: Open this URL to inspect the generated SP metadata that Better Auth exposes for this provider.
fields.idpIssuerHelp: Optional. Use this if your IdP gives you a specific issuer or entity ID value.
fields.appCallbackPathHelp: Where the user should land in your app after Better Auth finishes the SAML login flow.
fields.idpAudienceHelp: Optional. Leave this alone unless your IdP setup explicitly tells you to override the audience.
fields.certificateHelp: Paste the X.509 signing certificate from your IdP. Okta provides this in the SAML app sign-on instructions.
fields.metadataHint: Paste the IdP metadata XML here if you have it. For SAMLtest, this lets Better Auth store the metadata alongside the core SAML fields.
fields.samltestMetadataHint: Paste the SAMLtest IdP metadata XML here if you want Better Auth to store the metadata alongside the core SAML fields.
fields.oktaMetadataHint: Paste the metadata XML exported from your Okta SAML application, or enter the issuer, entry point, and certificate values manually.

errors.ssoRegister: Unable to register the SSO provider.
errors.ssoMetadataInvalid: The metadata XML could not be parsed. Check that you pasted valid SAML metadata.
errors.ssoMetadataIncomplete: The metadata XML is missing a required entity ID, SSO URL, or signing certificate.
